text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooh!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: What an incredible voice...! How could—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—She's tied it! She's finally tied the 
record! Almond Eye achieves her 7th turf 
GⅠ victoryyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the Victoria Mile, I had been 
focusing entirely on her physical 
condition, so I had completely forgotten 
about it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye has— at last, stood shoulder to 
shoulder with history.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ah! So that's it—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
choice_data_list: Ai! That's amazing... I'm so happy...!!
Ai! That's amazing... I'm so happy...!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes, really! —I'm so, so happy!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ……Aaaaargh!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I've made up my mind!! I will... 
definitely race against Ai-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Just you wait, Ai-senpaaai! —In the mile!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ai-chaaangh, you're way too incredibleee!! 
You definitely gotta win the next one 
too--!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Wait, like... hold on...! If she wins the 
next one too... if she can win...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eyeeeee!! Next up—surpassing Rudolf 
with 8 turf G1 victories!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"We're counting on youuu!!" "Rewrite 
historyyyy!!" "You're the one who will 
surpass the past!!"
choice_data_list:
(That's right, if we win the next one... 
that'll be eight turf G1 wins)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A view beyond what anyone—including 
Symboli Rudolf—could ever reach... An 
untrodden realm high up in the endless 
sky...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If she reaches that point, even those who 
doubt Almond Eye's strength will have to 
admit that she has 'achieved what no one 
else could.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The venue's expectations lean toward an 
unprecedented feat... and swell all at 
once. The moment she felt that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt a dizzying sensation, as if the 
ground beneath my feet were giving way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like the Umamusume who made it so 
close, only to taste defeat.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Let's head back! I want to talk about 
what's next—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I see. —Yet another has reached it.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"First off, congratulations on your 7th 
turf GⅠ victory! With this, you've tied 
with historic, legendary Umamusume, 
but...!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! First of all, I'm 
just so happy that I won!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's just like you, Ai-san! Numbers 
don't matter... but still—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"We can't help but dream... of you 
breaking down the wall...!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. I don't know how tall or 
how unyielding that wall is.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Still... if it makes someone happy, I 
think I want to try breaking through too!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
When will that day come?! —In which race 
will we witness this historic feat!?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Here... Trainer, this is for you!
choice_data_list:
...First, let's recover from the fatigue 
of back-to-back races.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes! With the training camp coming up, 
looks like I'll spend the summer focusing 
on self-care.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“However, I don't intend to take things so 
leisurely. ……Right?”
choice_data_list:
Yeah. Our next goal is the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)

Yeah. The next goal is the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: (Oooooooh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A crucial GⅠ race of the autumn... A stage 
rich in tradition and prestige is truly 
worthy of such a magnificent feat.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...So that's the race that moves your 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
And so, next is the Tenno Sho (Autumn)— 
and I will win it!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
If it's you, Almond Eye-san, you can 
definitely achieve 8 turf G1 wins...! All 
that's left is waiting for that day to 
come!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I certainly believe in her. However— a 
certain phrase weighs heavily on my heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "There are no absolutes in racing"—
